styleLock.backgroundSystem: three locked fields only: a matte rose-clay field #E3D3CE for hero and mechanism screens, a shell-white information card #FAF6F2 for grids and specification screens, and one deep berry-ink field #3A2A33 reserved for the closing and macro screens; every field is flat, horizonless and gradient-free, and consecutive screens swap between them
styleLock.lightingSystem: broad diffused butterfly key from just above the lens axis with generous fill, controlled soft specular on the exposed sponge face, one believable contact shadow under every base, no hard cast shadow and no dramatic rim except a single thin lid-edge rim on the closing screen
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte laminated card stock in shell-white #FAF6F2 and rose-clay #E3D3CE, one shallow matte porcelain-tone disc tray #D8C3BC, pale rose-clay cloth #D8C3BC for the single lifestyle corner
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif for headlines with one thin humanist companion for labels; three-layer text budget per screen of one headline rail, up to four short label rails and one button line, all set in #4A3B41 on light fields and #F2E4DE on the ink field
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line pictograms drawn inside blank circular discs hung on one hairline orbit ring in #C0876B, single stroke weight, never filled badges, never shields, never certificates
styleLock.presentationRules: the compact always reads at the same opened hinge angle with the sponge face turned toward the lens, product scale locked across screens, lids and refill cases shown as plain unbranded shells with empty artwork rectangles
noDrift: no colour palette changes outside #E3D3CE, #FAF6F2, #3A2A33 and #C0876B
no mixed fonts and no dense body copy blocks
no floating spheres, pearls, bubbles, splash, mist or vapor motifs anywhere in the set
no gradients, horizon lines, scenery or architectural backdrop
no identifiable face, portrait, eye or lip study in any panel
no numerals inside any dial, meter, table cell or badge
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent luminous base-makeup commerce system across the entire image set; fixed palette of matte rose-clay field #E3D3CE, shell-white information card #FAF6F2, deep berry-ink closing field #3A2A33 and one rose-copper accent #C0876B, with #4A3B41 reserved for headline type on light fields and #F2E4DE on the ink field; neutral studio grade; broad diffused butterfly key from just above the lens axis with generous fill, controlled soft specular on the sponge face and one contact shadow under every base; matte laminated card surfaces with one shallow porcelain-tone disc tray #D8C3BC, no horizon line and no gradient; modern geometric sans-serif headline with one thin humanist label companion, three-layer text budget of one headline rail plus short label rails plus one button line; thin-line pictograms inside blank circular discs on one hairline orbit ring in #C0876B, never filled badges or certificates; the compact keeps the same opened hinge angle, the sponge face toward the lens and a stable product scale; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no dense body copy, no floating spheres or bubbles or mist, no gradients or horizon or scenery, no identifiable face, no numerals inside dials or meters or table cells.

provenance.notes:
【逐屏事实】panel-01 开盖气垫悬浮于珠光球体之间的暖米色卖点大图；panel-02 悬浮开盖机＋品牌／规格／保质期／使用肤质／作用／方法六行参数卡＋痛点屏标题；panel-03 四张外模面部与皮肤特写的二乘二四格痛点图＋持妆大字标题与放射刻度环；panel-04 圆盘状海绵气垫芯微距被一圈刻度环包住，下方三块小标题机制说明；panel-05 梳成旋涡状的破碎粉体顶视图＋两枚圆形粉扑正反面带弧形文字；panel-06 开盖气垫居中、七枚六边形图标牌环绕＋粉底溢流与珠饰，下方试用测评标题；panel-07 三组 Before/After 六格（含水分值仪器读数与两块空白图框）；panel-08 四宫格空白步骤图框＋四个文字步骤；panel-09 手持开盖气垫对镜按压粉扑（镜中仅为手）与白面空壳气垫细节图；panel-10 指尖按压海绵孔洞极限微距，左下角带会员角标与二维码。
【品类判定】源夹名仅作线索。硬证据：panel-02 参数卡的品名栏写的是气垫BB霜、其方法栏按取料—拍开—局部加层的顺序描述上妆动作，panel-01／06／09／10 实物均为黑色翻盖圆盒＋海绵气垫芯＋带缎带粉扑＋盖内镜子，成品是覆盖在皮肤上的着色层而非护理乳液。因此属彩妆中的底妆品，判定为 美妆彩妆／底妆（非 护肤个护／面部护理：无泵瓶精华质地、无护肤类使用步骤，且核心叙述是遮瑕与贴肤着色）。
【已剥离内容】原品牌字标与系列名、参数字段的中文标签与原句、原页所有标题与正文文案、四张外籍模特的面部与五官、Before/After 仪器读数与页面对比数值、海绵孔洞尺寸与孔数数字、粉扑弧形原句、六边形图牌内的原字样、珠光球体与溢流粉底装饰、右下角会员角标与二维码、任何平台与店铺字样；产品一律以 {product} 占位，全部数值改为空白卡位或 {callout_1} 类占位，四格与六格图位保持空白供后期实拍替换；源页自述的多种功效与覆盖全部肤质的适用断言一律不作为事实写入。
【合并与取舍】10 屏合并为 11 镜：panel-03 的痛点四格与 panel-07 的六格对比拆成 PAIN_POINT 与 COMPARISON 两镜；panel-04 的刻度环机制微距与 panel-10 的指尖按压微距合并为 shot-05；panel-06 的环绕卖点屏改为 shot-02 的圆牌环形盘；panel-02 参数卡→shot-07，panel-05 材质屏→shot-06，panel-08 步骤屏→shot-09，panel-09 手持镜→shot-08 并以 shot-10 收纳平铺承担信任职能，收口以 shot-11 空白按钮位收。
